page.overview:
Who is Alexandra Elise O'Neill?

Alexandra Elise O'Neill is a world traveler and smuggler in the one-shot where she was played by Marisha Ray. In , she appeared as the Lightkeeper. As an NPC, she was portrayed by Matthew Mercer.

During the events of Candela Obscura, she was in her mid-fifties, with brown skin and gray-streaked hair pulled up in thick locks falling past her shoulders. Her right eye was clouded white. Her face bore heavy scars streaking downward through her eye and cheek, resembling lightning bolts.

Alexandra described herself as "a bon vivant, bit of an adventurer".

Alexandra has spent much of her recent time in India, helping the Likir monks hold a monster called "the village of the hungry night" at bay. They sent her back to London to retrieve a jade planchette to aid in their task. This led her to accept Rupert Merriweather's job at the Crystal Palace, as the planchette was reported to be there.
